div.p: In a shared research environment, one "greedy" user might submit 100 training jobs, locking out everyone else.

p.span: allow you to create "Resource Flavors" and "Workload Priorities."

li.p: Preemption: You can configure the scheduler so that a high-priority "Inference" pod (serving a live model) can "evict" a low-priority "Research Training" pod if GPU resources become scarce.

div.div: If multiple teams (e.g., Data Science vs. Research) share a cluster, "Fair Sharing" ensures that if the cluster is idle, one team can take it all, but as soon as the other team submits a job, the first team's "over-quota" pods are preempted to give the second team their fair share.

div.span: You give the "Marketing Team" a namespace with a hard limit of 10 GPUs.
div.p:
The Failure Point: Standard ResourceQuotas are static and "dumb."
If Marketing isn't using their 10 GPUs, those GPUs sit empty. Other teams cannot borrow them.
div.span: If a team hits their limit, their pod just
immediately with an error. It doesn't "wait in line" (queue) to start automatically when space opens up.
